$Comment: Santa, Christmas's host, who sets up by his tree in the Forgotten Temple while Christmas runs. A thin Variant: Template_Zig_QuestGiver, shipped by Ziggfreed's CommonLib, holds the whole body (standing, watching, the press-F action), and this file only says how Santa looks, what he holds and how he reads. Modify may name only the five parameters that template declares: Appearance, NameTranslationKey, Weapons, OffHand and DefaultOffHandSlot. Naming anything else makes the game refuse the whole role, and the only sign in game is a Santa who never appears. Appearance is Models/Christmas/NPC/Christmas_Santa.json, the game's own Santa model (NPC_Santa: the red coat, hat and boots and the long white beard) unchanged but for the Wave animation the template plays when a player walks up, which the game's Santa lacks. OffHand puts a Christmas Present (this pack's Christmas_Present) in his off hand, and DefaultOffHandSlot 0 has him hold it from the start; Weapons is left out, so his main hand stays empty. Swap the present for any other item id a player can hold, or drop both keys to empty his hands. NameTranslationKey is the nameplate, in this pack's npcs.lang. NpcPlacements/Christmas_Santa_Temple.json stands Santa in the temple, and only while Christmas runs.
